summary: Frontend-only test of Performance Lab Phase 3 completed successfully. All required data-testids present and functional: report card, gain +15.84%, validation block, synergy, BIOS suggestions with ReBAR details (3 numbered steps + why), performance index. Share button triggered actual PNG download 'frameforge-lab-report.png'. Nuova sessione opens setup with fleet-hint (69 tests) and reboot toggle correctly changes candidates 14<->11. Reload preserves completed session/report.
action_items: MINOR (non-blocking): html-to-image logs two console errors when trying to inline google-fonts CSS rules (SecurityError: cross-origin CSSStyleSheet cssRules access). Download still succeeds and toast is issued, but request explicitly asked for zero console errors on Share. Consider either: (a) removing the Google Fonts <link> (Inter font) or self-hosting it, or (b) passing skipFonts: true / fontEmbedCSS: '' to toPng options to suppress the fetch and silence the console errors.
MINOR: three 401s on initial load (likely /agent/token or /lab/session while auth cookie is resolving) — cosmetic; page renders correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Lab.jsx is ~567 lines and mixes 10+ sub-components (SetupCard, ConnectCard, RebootBanner, SynergyCard, ValidationBlock, BaselineCard, Timeline, LogFeed, BiosSuggestions, ShareCard, ReportCard). Consider splitting into /pages/Lab/components/* for maintainability (>500 line threshold).
toPng options should include skipFonts:true (or cacheBust removed) to avoid cross-origin font CSS parse errors that pollute the console on every Share click.
seed_data_creation: None — used pre-existing completed Lab session in DB
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fase 3 Lab UI verified end-to-end on admin. Do NOT click lab-start-btn — it will consume the completed session. Reboot toggle default=on shows 14 candidates (3 with reboot); off shows 11. Fleet aggregate for this admin's hw_class shows 69 tests. Share flow performs actual file download (frameforge-lab-report.png) because navigator.canShare is absent in Playwright headless. html-to-image emits benign cross-origin CSS errors but still produces the PNG.
rca of the issue: Console SecurityError originates in html-to-image's parseWebFontRules which iterates document.styleSheets and calls .cssRules on the Google Fonts stylesheet loaded via <link rel=stylesheet href=https://fonts.googleapis.com/...>. Cross-origin stylesheets deny cssRules access. Fix: pass skipFonts:true to toPng, or self-host the Inter font, or wrap the call to suppress non-fatal errors.
